label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_lr_lower
rationale: Tight perturbation of pbt winner: slightly lower LR with same width=512/depth=4 to see if 3e-4 is right of optimum.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_lr_higher
rationale: Lr just above pbt winner (3e-4) to bracket optimum.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_wd_small
rationale: Add tiny weight decay to pbt winner (which had wd=0) — may help generalization slightly.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_drop015
rationale: Slightly more dropout on pbt winner — width=512/depth=4 may benefit from a bit more regularization.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_drop005
rationale: Slightly less dropout on pbt winner — test whether 0.1 is already enough.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_bs64
rationale: Smaller batch size with the pbt winner arch — more SGD noise sometimes helps small-data.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_bs256
rationale: Larger batch + linearly scaled LR to test BS=128 vs 256 with linear LR scaling on the wide arch.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_shift_aug
rationale: Pbt winner + rc_shift aug; shift augmentation often beats rev_complement-only on small data.

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_adam
rationale: Same as pbt winner but plain Adam vs AdamW — when wd=0 the difference should be negligible (sanity check).

label: r2_d100k_exploit_pbt_winner_wd_mid
rationale: Mid weight decay (1e-4) like the depth=6 winner — see if it lifts the depth=4 base.

label: r2_d100k_explore_w512_d5
rationale: Depth=5 at width=512 — bridge between best depth=4 (test=0.4017) and depth=6 (test=0.4075).

label: r2_d100k_explore_w512_d6_low_drop
rationale: Depth=6 width=512 (the #3 config) but with lower dropout 0.2 and slightly higher LR — see if its 0.4 dropout was over-regularized.

label: r2_d100k_explore_w1024_d3
rationale: Go wider not deeper — width=1024 at depth=3 (similar params to 512x4).

label: r2_d100k_explore_w1024_d4
rationale: Aggressive scale-up: width=1024, depth=4. Needs more regularization (wd=1e-4, drop=0.2).

label: r2_d100k_explore_pyramid_w1024_taper
rationale: Pyramid width: wide early layers (better feature extraction), narrower later — often beats uniform width.

label: r2_d100k_explore_inverted_pyramid
rationale: Inverted pyramid: narrower early to wider later — classic CNN scaling pattern, contrast with taper.

label: r2_d100k_explore_w768_d5
rationale: Intermediate width 768, depth 5 — between 512x4 and 1024x4.

label: r2_d100k_explore_w512_d7
rationale: Push depth to 7 with width=512, heavier dropout=0.3 to prevent overfit.

label: r2_d100k_novel_pbt_winner_shift_drop015
rationale: Combo: shift aug + slightly higher dropout + tiny wd on pbt winner — multi-knob regularization with stronger aug.

label: r2_d100k_novel_ag_block_w512_d4
rationale: AG block_class (AlphaGenome-style block) with pbt winner geometry — different inductive bias may help.

label: r2_d100k_novel_plain_block_w512_d4
rationale: Plain block_class (no SE / inverted residual) — tests whether LegNet's eff block is critical at D=100k.

label: r2_d100k_novel_ks7_w512_d4
rationale: Larger kernel size ks=7 with pbt winner — wider receptive field may help on 600bp MPRA.

label: r2_d100k_novel_ks3_w512_d4
rationale: Smaller kernel ks=3 with pbt winner — more locality, fewer params per conv.

label: r2_d100k_novel_ks7_shift_d5
rationale: Combine ks=7 + shift aug + depth=5 — bigger receptive field + stronger aug for deeper net.

label: r2_d100k_novel_ag_block_w1024_d3_shift
rationale: Triple novel: AG block + width=1024 + shift aug — biggest departure from current frontier.
